from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentRecord(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single judgment document."""
    doc_title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the judgment document")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action or administrative act type as described in the document (e.g., '民事执行', '行政裁决')")
    cause_quote: str = Field(description="A verbatim excerpt from the document confirming the case cause")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgments: list[JudgmentRecord]
